scope: Runtime eligibility, deterministic single-primary selection, progressive loading, and consent-bound fallback

red_evidence.reason: the runtime eligibility and single-primary binding selection module was absent

assertions: eligibility filters integrity, contract, capability, host, runtime, channel, format, locale, output contract, action, permission, recipient, and budget before preference scoring
selection returns one deterministic compatible primary binding
progressive loading reads all binding identities but loads only the selected binding contract and resources
fallback that changes data recipients, cost, or permissions requires new consent
selection and fallback never install a missing skill implicitly

review.kind: separate primary-agent review because delegated review is disabled by session policy
